decisions.proposal: Propose 28 significant and 12 fractional digits for money/quantity/price, 16 fractional for FX, 50 working digits, half-even presentation and exact source reconciliation. Record calculated allocation residuals explicitly.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Reject unsupported precision with field evidence; qualify instrument/source bounds before freezing.
decisions.still_open: Unchanged: precision, rounding and reconciliation limits need worked coverage and justified engineering defaults.
decisions.evidence_needed: Worked cases, targeted offline correctness/spike evidence and owner agreement; not approval by this specification.

decisions.proposal: Propose 15 minutes with strict server_now < expires_at and sensitive-action assurance. Permit a logically consistent explicit subset only with a new hash and disclosed exclusions. Define expiry at trusted-writer transaction submission; completion can occur later because DynamoDB has no server-clock condition. Strict completion-before-expiry needs a different proved control.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Drafting can continue; activation requires an agreed expiry, assurance and subset policy.
decisions.still_open: Authentication assurance, expiry, revocation and concurrency enforcement, and retry proof.
decisions.evidence_needed: Worked cases, targeted offline correctness/spike evidence and owner agreement; not approval by this specification.

decisions.proposal: Propose trade-date exposure with receivable/payable until supported settlement, nonadditive observations and an owner-confirmed backfill cutover generation.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Never guess settlement. Unsupported negative/margin positions and material reconciliation conflicts block affected metrics. For an open cash difference, OWN-31's option read "A small difference leaves the return showing and flagged. Above a limit you approve, the return is withheld." The limit is not set yet (FIN-OD-01).
decisions.still_open: Settled on 5 November 2026: OWN-19 ("Whole history only"), the option read "A rebuild can be approved only when statements cover every unit. A part one stays held and visible."; OWN-31 ("Withhold only if material"), the option read "A small difference leaves the return showing and flagged. Above a limit you approve, the return is withheld." The material-difference limit stays open with FIN-OD-01's reconciliation limits. Still open: cutover, reconciliation and recovery proof, account edge cases, and the policy for unsupported negative or margin positions.

decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Coverage and close-time alignment need evidence. No full-risk claim from partial holdings or arbitrary covariance repair.
decisions.still_open: Unchanged: risk estimation windows, coverage, cross-market alignment and source freshness.

policy_receipts_2026_11_02.scope: 15-minute approval window for an exact approved import or correction; any change needs fresh approval; the window governs trusted-writer submission, not completion
An import may commit explicitly reviewed, complete transaction groups from a fresh exact proposal; dependent entries stay together; unresolved entries stay pending and visible
The combined score needs all three components (growth 35, protection 40, opportunity 25); no missing-as-zero, no silent reweighting
Trade-date holdings with settlement tracked separately; never a guessed settlement date or double-counted cash
A labelled analytical FIFO fallback when history supports it and no usable broker basis exists; broker figures kept; separate from tax basis
Core ledger, approval, audit, promotion and forecast/outcome evidence kept for the account's lifetime, subject to owner deletion and source-permission limits
A private export download link can start a download for one hour; a new authenticated request after expiry; not the stored export's retention
Later uploads that fill gaps behind a snapshot produce a versioned rebuild proposal for exact-content owner approval; earlier predictions unchanged
